artworks.title: Une Imitation bourgeoise du Zéphir de Prudhon
artworks.description: The image shows two figures in full body view. On the left, a man is sitting on the ground holding a tree branch above him. He has round facial features, small round glasses, short combed back hair, and is wearing loose-fitting clothing. On the right, a woman is standing, bending slightly forward towards the man. She has long hair under a fabric over her head, wearing a long gown. At her feet is a saddle. In the background, there is a large tree on the left, hilly landscapes, and an open sky. The image is in a sepia tone sketch style with handwritten text below.

artworks.title: Est-il permis de revenir... dans un état pareil...
artworks.description: The image shows three individuals. In the center, a man stands with one arm gesturing outward and the other arm resting on a piece of furniture. He appears disheveled with unkempt hair and a weary expression. To his left, a woman sits covering her face with her hands. She wears a long dress and her hair is tied up neatly. Beside the man, a child clings to his leg. The child is dressed in a striped top and dark pants. On the floor in front of them, there is a hat. In the background, there is a framed portrait on the wall. The room appears sparsely furnished.

artworks.title: Le Coup de vent
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a ship caught in a sudden gust of wind. The image depicts a leaning sailboat with two figures clinging to its mast as it is buffeted by strong winds, causing waves to form on the water. In the chaos, a hat is flying off into the air, while in the background, there is an audience of onlookers, possibly on a dock. The drawing employs fine line work and shading to create a sense of dynamism and motion, with the wind being almost palpable as it whips through the scene. It also includes handwritten text in French.

artworks.title: Une Réception
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of people gathered around a table in a celebratory scene. One figure on the left is pouring a drink over their head while holding a musical instrument, with liquid splashing. The other figures around the table raise their glasses in a toast. The drawing style emphasizes exaggerated expressions and dynamic movement, contributing to the humorous and lively nature of the scene. The overall composition suggests a jovial gathering, perhaps a celebration or a party, with the characters captured in a moment of lighthearted antics.

artworks.title: Carotte dramatique
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a theatrical performance. The drawing depicts a character on stage with outstretched arms and expressive posture, surrounded by billowing curtains or clouds. In the foreground, a person is seen sitting with sheet music open before them. The image captures a sense of theatrical drama and emotional intensity through the exaggerated gestures and dynamic composition. The monochromatic palette and sketchy lines add immediacy to the scene.

artworks.title: Une Guerrier électrisé
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting a person getting shocked while standing on a platform. Another person is seen operating an apparatus that triggers the electric shock. A group of onlookers, some wearing top hats, are observing the scene. The drawing shows detailed expressions and exaggerated reactions. The background includes shaded lines indicating a light crowd and additional activity. The artist has used pencil sketching to create expressive lines and textures, enhancing the lively and humorous energy of the scene.

artworks.title: Ma femme m'a dit: attends moi cinq minutes...
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing in profile under heavy rain. The person is holding an umbrella over their head with one hand and keeping the other hand close to their body. The individual has facial features including a long nose and prominent chin, with short hair barely visible under the rain and hat. They are dressed in a knee-length coat, trousers, and shoes, all of which are getting wet due to the rain. The person lacks visible jewelry. The background features a mix of dark and light, representing the heavy rain that blurs the surroundings, with handwritten text in French surrounding the illustration.

artworks.title: Monsieur... Monsieur, v'la vot' mouchoir
artworks.description: The drawing depicts a man and a woman in historical attire standing in the rain. The man holds an open umbrella above his head. He wears a tall hat, a long coat, and a sash across his chest. The woman reaches out to the man with one hand while holding a cloth. She wears a headscarf, a long dress, and an apron. Rain falls in the background on a stone-paved urban street.

artworks.title: Plus souvent que je te conduirai... au bal...
artworks.description: The image shows a man and a woman in a room. The woman is standing and facing the left side of the image. She is wearing a dark hooded garment, and her hands are gathered in front of her. The man is seated in a chair with his legs crossed and one arm resting on the chair back while the other is positioned on his head. He is wearing a top hat and a dark suit with a white shirt visible underneath. The room has a textured wall with a framed art piece and a tall vase on a pedestal to the left. The floor has a patterned rug. The overall setting is depicted in shades of black and white.

artworks.title: Allons bon!... voila les grafignons...
artworks.description: Two people are depicted in a vertical format, with their full bodies visible. They are positioned facing each other on a terrace or platform-like structure. The man on the right is raising his hat in his right hand, while the woman on the left looks up at him, her hands folded together at her waist. The man has a face with prominent features, receding hair, and is wearing a long coat with plaid trousers. The woman has her hair pulled back and is wearing a long, flowing dress. In the background, there are figures in motion waving hats, appearing to be a group of people walking along a pathway, with landscapes of open fields and trees. The background sketch is light. Text is written below the characters at the bottom of the image.

artworks.title: Allons bon!... voila que'elle me cueille une rose...
artworks.description: The image shows three individuals standing from head to toe. The person on the left has one hand in their pocket and wears a cap. The central figure wears a top hat and a dark coat, while the person on the right is touching a floral display and is facing away from the viewer. The scene is surrounded by bushes and flowers, with a shaded background and indistinct foliage. The style is sketch-like with emphasis on lines and shading.

artworks.title: Il n'y a pas a dire, il faut que je traverse ce... bois...
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing upright, holding a cane in front of him with both hands. He has a serious expression and is wearing a tall top hat, a dark suit, and a white shirt. A shadow of his figure is cast on a wall behind him. The background is dark with some vegetation visible.

artworks.title: Le Danger de... visiter un site par trop sauvage
artworks.description: This is a drawing of three figures engaged in an interaction in a wooded setting. The scene portrays two figures adjusting the clothing of a central figure who stands upright. The setting is in what appears to be a forest or garden with dense foliage in the background. The drawing is composed in monochromatic tones, typical of a sketch style, with detailing and shading that suggests texture and depth. The figures are dressed in European 19th-century attire, featuring top hats and suit coats. The arrangement and facial expressions suggest a narrative moment captured. The presence of text at the bottom suggests a caption.

artworks.title: Une Charge déplacée
artworks.description: The image shows a figure wearing a top hat, holding papers, with a dog in mid-motion in the foreground. Another figure is depicted in the background with smoky shapes around them. The style is reminiscent of Honoré Daumier, known for satirical and caricatured depictions.

artworks.title: Comme quoi l'emprisonnement cellulaire...
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a man sticking his tongue out. A person, seen in profile view, is leaning over a table with papers scattered across it. The background suggests an official setting with figures appearing to act in official capacities. Through a window, an older person wearing glasses observes the scene with a surprised or concerned expression. French text at the bottom of the drawing suggests commentary on imprisonment.

artworks.title: Le Dortoir d'un pensionnat bien tenu
artworks.description: The image depicts two groups of individuals in an interior setting. On the left side, a standing male figure is visible from the waist up, shown in profile. He appears to be gesturing with both hands raised. He has a prominent nose, a receding hairline, and slicked-back dark hair, wearing a dark jacket, a collared shirt, and a cravat or tie. To the right, there is a line of people mostly shown from the waist up, seated on a bench and looking towards the standing figure. These seated individuals are wearing matching garments, possibly robes, with distinctive conical hats. The background is dark, focusing the attention on the figures in the foreground. The scene is surrounded by handwritten text framing the bottom.

artworks.title: M'sieu... que c'est tannant d'avoir la colique quand...
artworks.description: The image shows a classroom with students sitting together. One student raises a hand while the teacher appears to be asleep at the desk.

artworks.title: Un Surveillant obligé de fermer l'oeil...
artworks.description: This is an image of a group scene during a snowball fight. The central figure is holding a top hat and gesturing animatedly. Surrounding them are smaller figures engaged in throwing snowballs, some of which are airborne. The setting includes outdoor elements like winter trees and a building.

artworks.title: Non, madame, je ne vous quitterai pas...
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals, a woman and a man, both in full view. The woman is walking towards the left side of the image, with her head turned away from the viewer. She wears a bonnet and a long dress. The man follows closely behind her, with his facial profile partially visible. He wears a top hat, a jacket, trousers, and carries a cane. The background features an urban setting with building facades and a glowing circle, possibly a street lamp.

artworks.title: Comme tu y vas...
artworks.description: The image shows two men standing on a paved surface. The man on the left is facing slightly sideways and appears to be speaking. He has a bald head with some hair on the sides and distinct facial features. He is dressed in a light-colored shirt, a dark waistcoat, trousers, and a jacket. The man on the right is facing forward with his head turned to the left. He has distinct facial features, a neatly groomed beard, and a full head of hair. He is wearing a dark suit with a waistcoat and a cravat. The background includes trees or bushes and a flight of stairs to the left. The sketchy background features handwritten text below and above the framed picture area.

artworks.title: Faut de la prudence père Balivot, vot petite a seize ans...
artworks.description: The image depicts two men from the waist up, engaged in a discussion. Each man is leaning over a table, with their upper bodies turned towards each other. The man on the left has distinct facial features, including a pointed nose and a pronounced brow, and is wearing a dark suit with a cap. The man on the right has similar facial features, is wearing a top hat and a light-colored coat. A wine bottle and glasses are on the table between them. The background is a plain wall with soft shadow detailing, and handwritten text and signatures are present at the top and bottom of the image.

artworks.title: Allons! mon jeune ami, une bonne poignée...
artworks.description: The image shows two men from the waist up engaging in a handshake. The man on the left has a tall, black top hat and is dressed in a dark coat, a vest, and trousers. The man on the right also wears a tall, black top hat and a similar dark coat. Both men have distinct facial features. The background is plain with handwritten text above and below the image, along with rough sketches and annotations.

artworks.title: Weislingen Attacked by the Forces of Goetz (Weislingen attaqué par les gens de Goetz)
artworks.medium: lithograph on chine collé on wove paper
artworks.description: This drawing shows an intense battle scene with riders on horseback. Two figures are engaged in combat, one on foot and the other mounted on a horse. The mounted figure is adorned in lavish attire and poised on a rearing horse. The artist uses dark, swirling strokes to convey movement, with fine lines detailing the figures' expressions and clothing. The background complements the central action of the scene.

artworks.title: Jean Duvet as Saint John the Evangelist
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 29.6 × 21 cm (11 5/8 × 8 1/4 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a city, a river, and various figures. The drawing is detailed, depicting a cityscape in the background with structures, archways, and towers. In the foreground, a robed figure is seated at a table with books and scrolls. To the right, a small boat sails along a river with figures standing on it. Clouds and waves are drawn to add depth to the water. On the lower right, a swan is depicted with an arrow pointing towards it, and there is an inscription on the wall beside it. Surrounding elements like trees, foliage, and animals add complexity to the scene.
